title: Hornero Chromatic template manifest
description: One manifest per template (RFC 0002 §12.2). The template file is relative to the manifest directory. `output` may only start with ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME}, ${XDG_CACHE_HOME}, ${XDG_DATA_HOME} or ~/ and must stay under them after symlink resolution. `adapter` names a fixed reload hook and is honoured for first-party manifests only. `requires` is a directory (same prefixes) that must exist for the template to render, so apps the user does not have are never given files. Grammar: {{ role }}, {{ role.hex|bare|rgb|r|g|b }}, {{ role.rgba A }}, {{ termN }}, {{ mode }}, {{ id }}, {{#dark}}..{{/dark}}, {{#light}}..{{/light}}; nothing else.

template.description: File name in the manifest directory (no path separators).
